name: hcportal_addEditProduct
description: Creates or edits one catalogue entry from the portal Products view. Portal twin of hcapp_addEditProduct: same table and rules, portal auth instead of device auth. Never deletes — taking something off sale is isActive = 0.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Routing: which kennel owns the product

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: NULL creates; otherwise edits that product, which must belong to this kennel

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: 2 membership, 3 haberdashery, 4 run package, 5 away weekend

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required in practice; a blank name is rejected

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Free text shown to the hasher

parameters.name: promotionalCredit
parameters.description: Credit granted on top of the cash

parameters.name: unitCost
parameters.description: What it costs the kennel to supply

parameters.name: runCount
parameters.description: Runs a package is worth; NULL otherwise

parameters.name: productDetailsJson
parameters.description: Per-type display detail. Rejected if not valid JSON

parameters.name: photoUrls
parameters.description: Pipe-delimited product photo URLs, never comma-delimited

parameters.name: sourceJson
parameters.description: Supplier detail. Rejected if not valid JSON. Never syncs to phones

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: On sale. Setting 0 is how a product is retired; the row keeps syncing

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Success = 1 with NULL ErrorMessage, or Success = 0 with the reason.

columns.name: productId
columns.description: The created or edited product id

sideEffects: Inserts or updates one HC.Product row
Sets Product.updatedAt explicitly; HC.Product has no UpdatedAt trigger, so omitting it would stop the row reaching phones
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
This SP must never delete a product; retirement is isActive = 0
